slides.texte_overlay:
5 Hobbies That Makes You
Extremely Intelligent

1. Learning a language.

trains memory, opens new ways
of thinking, makes travel
richer, connects you with
more people

2. Playing an instrument.

builds patience, trains
coordination and focus,
teaches you to practice
smart

3. Cooking from scratch.

teaches planning, timing
and chemistry without a
classroom, and feeds
your friends

4. Learning a little about
everything.

history, science, art in short
lessons, connects ideas across
fields, keeps you sharp
slides.texte_sophia:

slides.texte_overlay:
5. Building and fixing things.

trains problem solving,
spatial thinking and
patience, gives you
real-world skills
